title: Interpretable ML predicts hemorrhage in cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy surgery
summary: Eight machine-learning methods were trained on 1,680 patients with cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy from three hospitals, using nine selected variables; the best model (Bayes) had AUC 0.882. External validation at a fourth hospital gave AUC 0.853, accuracy 0.936, sensitivity 0.954 and specificity 0.5. The study is retrospective, specificity is low, and the model was deployed as a web application.
ai_technology: Random forest, Lasso, Boruta and XGBoost feature selection with eight machine-learning models
organization: Shandong University; Qilu Hospital of Shandong University

evidence.tested: Internal and external validation were run on retrospective electronic medical record data.
evidence.unknown: Prospective validation is still needed. Abstract-based; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: ML feature selection and model comparison produced a risk model for intraoperative hemorrhage.
